Name: All Garbage Cans
Author: MantraXS
Description:
[size=5][b]All Garbage Cans[/b][/size]

[i]中文介绍在下方[/i]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
Check any garbage can and every other can in Pelican Town gets checked too. All the loot pops out of the can you opened.

[list]
[*]Uses the vanilla garbage logic. Drop chances, loot tables and the once-per-day limit are unchanged.[/*]
[*]Compatible with mods that change garbage cans, such as Binning Skill.[/*]
[*]Nearby villagers react only to the can you opened. Chained cans cost no extra friendship.[/*]
[*]English and Simplified Chinese, following the game language.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Edit in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional), or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].

[list]
[*][b]Enabled[/b] (default: on): master switch.[/*]
[*][b]Include all locations[/b] (default: off): also chain cans outside Pelican Town, such as cans added by map mods.[/*]
[*][b]Delay between cans[/b] (default: 200 ms): 0 opens all cans at once.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Unzip into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] and launch the game with SMAPI. Safe to add or remove mid-save.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Multiplayer has not been tested yet. Please report any issues.

[line]

[size=5][b]全镇垃圾桶[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]功能[/b][/size]
翻任意一个垃圾桶，鹈鹕镇其余的垃圾桶也会跟着翻开，所有东西都从你翻的那个桶里跳出来。

[list]
[*]使用原版翻桶逻辑，掉落概率、掉落表和每天一次的限制都不变。[/*]
[*]兼容修改垃圾桶的 mod，例如 Binning Skill。[/*]
[*]附近村民只对你亲手翻的桶有反应，连锁翻的桶不额外扣好感。[/*]
[*]支持英文和简体中文，跟随游戏语言。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]设置[/b][/size]
可用 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]（可选）在游戏内修改，或编辑 [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]。

[list]
[*][b]启用[/b]（默认：开）：总开关。[/*]
[*][b]包含所有地点[/b]（默认：关）：同时连锁鹈鹕镇以外的垃圾桶，例如地图 mod 添加的桶。[/*]
[*][b]每个桶的间隔[/b]（默认：200 毫秒）：设为 0 则同时全部翻开。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]安装[/b][/size]
解压到 [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]，通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。可随时在存档中途添加或移除。

[size=4][b]兼容性[/b][/size]
多人模式尚未测试，遇到问题欢迎反馈。
